body: Taleb defines a Black Swan as an event outside normal expectations.
Afterward, explanations make it seem predictable.
Hindsight hides how surprising it was.
The name recalls Europe's old belief that all swans were white.
Europeans later encountered black swans in Australia.
One observation shattered a rule that seemed certain.
Taleb says forecasts can fail the same way.
Markets can be transformed by events models barely considered.
Technologies can overturn assumptions just as suddenly.
You cannot reliably predict every Black Swan.
So reduce dependence on fragile forecasts.
optional_closing: Leave room for error before surprise arrives.
full_narration: Sorting tools, a missing wrench sparks a question: what does Taleb mean by a Black Swan? I open Taleb's book and follow the answer. Taleb defines a Black Swan as an event outside normal expectations. Its impact is enormous. Afterward, explanations make it seem predictable. Hindsight hides how surprising it was. The name recalls Europe's old belief that all swans were white. Europeans later encountered black swans in Australia. One observation shattered a rule that seemed certain. Taleb says forecasts can fail the same way. Markets can be transformed by events models barely considered. Technologies can overturn assumptions just as suddenly. You cannot reliably predict every Black Swan. So reduce dependence on fragile forecasts. Leave room for error before surprise arrives. Like and subscribe to grow more questions.
